tools.name: plivo_get_account
tools.description: Get the Plivo account for the configured Auth ID: name, account type (standard or developer trial), billing mode and remaining cash credits in USD. Good first call to check the connection. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/.

tools.name: plivo_list_messages
tools.description: List SMS and MMS message detail records on the account, newest first, with direction, state, from/to numbers, and charges. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/.

tools.name: plivo_get_message
tools.description: Get one message detail record by message_uuid: state (queued, sent, delivered, failed, ...), error_code, from and to numbers, and total_amount. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/{message_uuid}/.

tools.name: plivo_send_sms
tools.description: Send one SMS to one recipient from a sender number. This sends a real text message that costs money and cannot be recalled. Plain SMS only (no MMS, no WhatsApp). Plivo API: POST /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Message/ with type=sms.

tools.name: plivo_list_calls
tools.description: List voice calls on the account. Use status=live for calls in progress or status=queued for calls waiting to start. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/.

tools.name: plivo_get_call
tools.description: Get one call by call_uuid: status, direction, from and to numbers, duration, and billing. Plivo API: GET /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/{call_uuid}/.

tools.name: plivo_make_call
tools.description: Start one outbound voice call. Plivo rings the 'to' number and, when answered, requests answer_url, which must return Plivo XML. This places a real call that costs money and cannot be recalled. Plivo API: POST /v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plivo_list_messages, plivo_get_message · Private data: plivo_list_messages, plivo_get_message · Public sink: plivo_list_messages, plivo_send_sms, plivo_make_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plivo_list_messages, plivo_get_message · Private data: plivo_list_messages, plivo_get_message · Public sink: plivo_list_messages, plivo_send_sms, plivo_make_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
